name: Peripheral Battery Panel
description:
Peripheral Battery Panel for Corsair XENEON Edge.

See the charge level of supported Corsair wireless devices in one dedicated battery dashboard. Devices are discovered automatically from the battery sensors already available in iCUE, with the lowest charge sorted first so the peripheral most likely to die is always the easiest to spot.

Charging is treated separately from charge level with a persistent charging badge and patterned battery fill, so a low device that is plugged in still reads as low.

Small layouts keep the two lowest devices visible. Medium, Large and Extra Large layouts expand into full battery cards with large touch friendly metrics.

Tap any device card to switch from percentage to the battery detail iCUE actually exposes. A remaining time estimate is shown only when that information is explicitly supplied by the provider. The widget never guesses battery life from percentage.

Set your own low battery threshold and personalize the text, accent and background colors.

No account, helper app or external service is required.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial release. Automatic discovery of supported iCUE battery sensors, lowest charge first sorting, low battery threshold alerts, distinct charging treatment, touch battery details, deliberate empty and unavailable states, local last known readings, and tuned layouts for S, M, L and XL in horizontal and vertical orientations.
